1	"""Vocabulary-based typo correction for search queries and addresses.
2	
3	Only whole alphabetic tokens that are absent from the catalog vocabulary are touched.
4	Each is replaced by the closest vocabulary word (Damerau-Levenshtein, at most one edit
5	for tokens up to six characters and two edits for longer ones), with ties broken by
6	catalog frequency. Digits, short tokens (under five letters), and words already in the
7	vocabulary are kept, as is any token that is a prefix of a vocabulary word (the user is still
8	typing; the engine matches prefixes). A candidate must share the first letter and occur at least 30 times in
9	the catalog or belong to the explicit brand allowlist; these guards eliminate harmful false-positive fixes
10	(`pigroup` to `group`, `lexi` to `levi`, `halalmart` to `hallmark`).
11	"""
12	
13	from __future__ import annotations
14	
15	import lzma
16	import re
17	from bisect import bisect_left
18	from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator, Mapping
19	from functools import lru_cache
20	from pathlib import Path
21	from typing import Any, Final
22	
23	from rapidfuzz.distance import DamerauLevenshtein
24	from rapidfuzz.process import extract
25	
26	from ..grammar.sanitizers import VOCAB_ALPHA_WORD_RE as _ALPHA_WORD_RE
27	from .text_utils import build_term_automaton, replace_terms_automaton
28	from .unicode import normalize_ascii
29	
30	_SHORT_TOKEN_MAX_EDITS: Final = 1
31	_LONG_TOKEN_MAX_EDITS: Final = 2
32	_SHORT_TOKEN_LENGTH: Final = 6
33	_CANDIDATE_LIMIT: Final = 8
34	
35	_ARTIFACT_DIR: Final[Path] = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "artifacts"
36	
37	
38	def _register_brand_allowlist(vocab: dict[str, int], brands: Iterable[str]) -> None:
39	    """Ensure all allowlisted brand words exist in vocabulary with candidate frequency floor."""
40	    for w in brands:
41	        vocab[w] = max(vocab.get(w, 0), 100)
42	
43	
44	def _register_canonical_targets(vocab: dict[str, int], targets: Iterable[str]) -> None:
45	    """Ensure constituent words of canonical targets exist in vocabulary with candidate floor."""
46	    for target in targets:
47	        for word in target.split():
48	            w_norm = normalize_ascii(word).lower()
49	            if w_norm:
50	                vocab[w_norm] = max(vocab.get(w_norm, 0), 100)
51	
52	
53	def iter_vocab_tokens(text: str) -> Iterator[str]:
54	    """Yield ASCII-folded, lower-cased alphabetic words of two or more letters."""
55	    for match in _ALPHA_WORD_RE.finditer(text):
56	        yield normalize_ascii(match.group()).lower()
57	
58	
59	def write_vocab(path: Path, counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> None:
60	    """Write ``word<TAB>count`` lines, most frequent first."""
61	    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
62	    lines = (f"{word}\t{count}" for word, count in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]))
63	    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
64	
65	
66	def load_vocab(path: Path) -> dict[str, int]:
67	    """Read a vocabulary written by :func:`write_vocab` or compressed with .xz."""
68	    raw = (
69	        lzma.decompress(path.read_bytes()).decode("utf-8")
70	        if path.suffix == ".xz"
71	        else path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
72	    )
73	    return {
74	        w: int(c)
75	        for line in raw.splitlines()
76	        for w, _, c in (line.partition("\t"),)
77	        if w and c.isdigit()
78	    }
79	
80	
81	def load_lexicon(path: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
82	    """Read a typo-to-target lexicon (word<TAB>target) compressed with .xz or plain."""
83	    raw = (
84	        lzma.decompress(path.read_bytes()).decode("utf-8")
85	        if path.suffix == ".xz"
86	        else path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
87	    )
88	    return {
89	        t.strip(): target.strip()
90	        for line in raw.splitlines()
91	        for t, _, target in (line.partition("\t"),)
92	        if t and target
93	    }
94	
95	
96	class QueryCorrector:
97	    """Replace out-of-vocabulary alphabetic tokens with their closest catalog word."""
98	
99	    def __init__(
100	        self,
101	        vocab: Mapping[str, int],
102	        *,
103	        min_token_length: int = 5,
104	        min_candidate_count: int = 30,
105	        min_prefix_count: int = 5,
106	        brand_allowlist: frozenset[str] | None = None,
107	        lexicon: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
108	    ) -> None:
109	        self._brand_allowlist = brand_allowlist or frozenset()
110	        self._vocab = dict(vocab)
111	        _register_brand_allowlist(self._vocab, self._brand_allowlist)
112	        self._lexicon = dict(lexicon) if lexicon else {}
113	        _register_canonical_targets(self._vocab, self._lexicon.values())
114	        self._lexicon_automaton = build_term_automaton(self._lexicon) if self._lexicon else None
115	        self._min_token_length = min_token_length
116	        self._min_prefix_count = min_prefix_count
117	        self._known_words = {
118	            w
119	            for w, count in self._vocab.items()
120	            if count >= min_prefix_count or w in self._brand_allowlist
121	        }
122	        self._prefix_words = sorted(self._known_words)
123	        self._sorted_words = self._prefix_words
124	        self._words_by_start_and_length: dict[tuple[str, int], list[str]] = {}
125	        for word, count in self._vocab.items():
126	            if count >= min_candidate_count or word in self._brand_allowlist:
127	                self._words_by_start_and_length.setdefault((word[0], len(word)), []).append(word)
128	        self._nearest = lru_cache(maxsize=65_536)(self._nearest_uncached)
129	
130	    @classmethod
131	    def from_file(
132	        cls,
133	        path: Path,
134	        *,
135	        lexicon_path: Path | None = None,
136	        **kwargs: Any,
137	    ) -> QueryCorrector:
138	        """Load vocabulary file; optionally load empirical typo lexicon."""
139	        if not path.is_file():
140	            raise FileNotFoundError(f"Query vocabulary not found: {path}")
141	        vocab = load_vocab(path)
142	        lexicon = load_lexicon(lexicon_path) if lexicon_path and lexicon_path.is_file() else None
143	        return cls(vocab, lexicon=lexicon, **kwargs)
144	
145	    @classmethod
146	    def load_packaged_lexicon(cls) -> QueryCorrector | None:
147	        """Load default packaged vocabulary artifact from ``vihap/artifacts/`` if present."""
148	        for name in ("query_lexicon.tsv.xz", "query_lexicon.tsv", "vocab.tsv.xz", "vocab.tsv"):
149	            candidate = _ARTIFACT_DIR / name
150	            if candidate.is_file():
151	                return cls.from_file(candidate)
152	        return None
153	
154	    def correct(self, text: str) -> str:
155	        """Return ``text`` with misspelled alphabetic tokens replaced."""
156	        if not text:
157	            return "" if text is None else text
158	        if self._lexicon_automaton is not None:
159	            text = replace_terms_automaton(text, self._lexicon_automaton)
160	        return _ALPHA_WORD_RE.sub(self._replace, text)
161	
162	    def _replace(self, match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
163	        token = match.group()
164	        folded = normalize_ascii(token).lower()
165	        if folded in self._lexicon:
166	            return self._lexicon[folded]
167	        if (
168	            len(folded) < self._min_token_length
169	            or folded in self._brand_allowlist
170	            or self._is_known_or_prefix(folded)
171	        ):
172	            return token
173	        return self._nearest(folded) or token
174	
175	    def _is_known_or_prefix(self, folded: str) -> bool:
176	        if folded in self._vocab:
177	            return True
178	        index = bisect_left(self._prefix_words, folded)
179	        return index < len(self._prefix_words) and self._prefix_words[index].startswith(folded)
180	
181	    def _nearest_uncached(self, folded: str) -> str | None:
182	        max_edits = (
183	            _SHORT_TOKEN_MAX_EDITS if len(folded) <= _SHORT_TOKEN_LENGTH else _LONG_TOKEN_MAX_EDITS
184	        )
185	        pool = [
186	            word
187	            for length in range(len(folded) - max_edits, len(folded) + max_edits + 1)
188	            for word in self._words_by_start_and_length.get((folded[0], length), ())
189	        ]
190	        matches = extract(
191	            folded,
192	            pool,
193	            scorer=DamerauLevenshtein.distance,
194	            score_cutoff=max_edits,
195	            limit=_CANDIDATE_LIMIT,
196	        )
197	        if not matches:
198	            return None
199	        best_distance = matches[0][1]
200	        closest = [word for word, distance, _ in matches if distance == best_distance]
201	        return max(closest, key=lambda word: self._vocab.get(word, 0))
202	
203	
204	@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
205	def get_default_query_corrector() -> QueryCorrector | None:
206	    """Return cached default QueryCorrector instance loaded from artifacts or data/."""
207	    corrector = QueryCorrector.load_packaged_lexicon()
208	    if corrector is not None:
209	        return corrector
210	    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
211	    vocab_path = root / "data" / "vocab.tsv"
212	    lex_path = root / "data" / "query_lexicon.tsv.xz"
213	    if vocab_path.is_file():
214	        return QueryCorrector.from_file(
215	            vocab_path, lexicon_path=lex_path if lex_path.is_file() else None
216	        )
217	    return None
218	
219	
220	__all__ = [
221	    "QueryCorrector",
222	    "get_default_query_corrector",
223	    "iter_vocab_tokens",
224	    "load_lexicon",
225	    "load_vocab",
226	    "write_vocab",
227	]
